fields.name: front_view
fields.description: Identify the product’s visible front or principal face, including its actual packaging front; do not guess orientation from an ambiguous crop.

fields.name: logo
fields.description: Identify a visible brand mark on the actual product or packaging; exclude watermarks, promotional overlays and branding on unrelated props.

fields.name: human_interaction
fields.description: Identify visible human contact with the actual product, such as holding, touching or carrying; a nearby person alone is insufficient.

fields.name: rich_environment
fields.description: Identify the product or attributable application/result in a relevant setting with visible contextual detail; a plain backdrop alone does not qualify.

fields.name: side_view
fields.description: Identify a visibly supported side/profile surface; a three-quarter image may also show a front or back surface.

fields.name: back_view
fields.description: Identify the visible rear/reverse surface from actual construction; do not infer it from symmetry or an ambiguous pose.

fields.name: surface_detail
fields.description: Identify a recognizable close-up of product texture, finish, colour, joins or construction; do not infer material composition.

fields.name: interior_visible
fields.description: Identify a genuine view into the item’s open storage space, showing actual lining, slots or compartments.

fields.name: closure_detail
fields.description: Identify actual visible zips, clasps, drawcords, hinges or clips in their pictured state; do not infer hidden mechanisms.

fields.name: carried_or_worn
fields.description: Identify the actual item visibly carried, worn or pulled as appropriate to its design; do not infer capacity or fit.

fields.name: multi_pack
fields.description: Identify separate products of the same kind shown as a catalog assortment, including variants; exclude repeated views of one item, unrelated props and packaging art mistaken for units.

fields.name: combo
fields.description: Identify different product types visibly represented together as a catalog set, supported by item context; exclude unrelated props, duplicate views and packaging art mistaken for actual items.

fields.name: ignore
fields.description: Ignore only when neither the catalog product nor an attributable application/result or contents depiction is identifiable, or dominant text prevents assessing that evidence. Unbranded items are valid.
